inputs: accepted V4-02 R6 head and external acceptance
accepted manifest and existing V4-02 daily/status/weekly/monthly/price-limit artifacts
checks: alias and adjusted daily hashes match accepted manifest
trading-status key set equals R8 universe keys
dated isST key set equals R8 universe keys
price-limit key set equals R8 universe keys
adjusted daily keys and dated boards are compatible with R8 universe keys
weekly and monthly identities are subsets of R8 universe identities
weekly and monthly identity-period keys are unique
rebuild_policy: NO_REBUILD; a new counterexample is scoped and handled separately
pass_policy: All required-scope key, identity, board and manifest comparisons pass while the accepted V4-02 external head remains current.
